inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The Broken Wastes, a scorching desert of golden dunes where sand sharks hunt under the sand and the Clarth war hunters make their camp. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. One whole region shown as one wide connected panorama, read left to right in three places: the outer dunes, then the shark graveyard, then the clarth war camp. Bare at the left, more and more built up toward the chief's place at the right end. Every part continues into the next with the same light, the same horizon and the same floor; nothing is repeated.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Hard bright noon sun from the upper left, short cool violet shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the salt flat arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#3d8fd6", "#8cc8ee", "#f2e2b8", "#e8b45a", "#d0903c", "#a8682c", "#efe6cf", "#c9b994", "#8a4a2c", "#c43a2e", "#c08a3a", "#4a3a5c", "#d8d4dc", "#b4aec0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky above a distant horizon with the region's landmark. Behind the arena the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths, with one big set piece for each of the three places and low framing pieces in the near foreground. The lower part is one flat calm arena floor running the whole width.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 260, 1000], "desc": "a hot clear deep blue sky, paler and golden near the horizon, a white sun high at the upper left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [143, 0, 442, 1000], "desc": "a long line of golden dunes and red rock mesas on the horizon, and far away at the right end the colossal sun bleached jawbone of a giant sand shark arching over the dunes, the region's landmark"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [364, 0, 559, 1000], "desc": "behind the arena: rippled dunes, half buried shark ribs, rusted wrecked siege machines of earlier armies, sparse at the left and denser toward the war camp"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 92, 611, 242], "desc": "the first place, the bare outskirts: a wooden lifeguard tower standing alone in the desert with a skeleton lifeguard still sitting in it, a wooden sign that says NO SWIMMING, and a shark fin cutting through the sand beside it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [39, 399, 625, 600], "desc": "the second place, one big set piece: the giant skeleton of a sand shark rising out of the dunes, its huge ribcage arching high like a gate, its open jaw war banners, bronze braziers burning, the chief's raised bone throne, the biggest and most built up place"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [533, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty, cracked pale salt
